default-src.description: The fallback for other fetch directives that aren't explicitly specified.

script-src.description: Controls which scripts can be executed on the page.

style-src.description: Controls which stylesheets can be applied to the page.

img-src.description: Controls which images can be loaded on the page.

frame-src.description: Controls which origins can be embedded as iframes.

font-src.description: Controls which fonts can be loaded on the page.

media-src.description: Controls which origins can provide audio and video resources.

connect-src.description: Controls which origins can be reached via Fetch, XHR, WebSockets, etc.

worker-src.description: Controls which origins can provide Web, Shared, or Service Worker scripts. Workers can complicate content security policy enforcement.

child-src.description: Defines the valid sources for web workers and nested browsing contexts (like iframes).

manifest-src.description: Controls which origins can provide the web app manifest, which defines how the application looks and behaves when installed on a device (e.g. name, icons, and theme).

object-src.description: Controls which origins can be embedded via <object>, <embed>, or <applet>.

sandbox.description: Isolates the document in a unique origin and blocks scripts, cookies, forms, popups, and downloads unless explicitly allowed.
